battle.name: 唐弼起義
battle.brief: 隋大業十年（614）二月丁酉，關中扶風郡賊帥唐弼聚眾十萬，立李弘芝為天子，號唐王，據扶風郡城與汧源一帶。此役正值隋煬帝第三次征高句麗、天下失序之際，關中饑荒、郡兵空虛，叛軍與官軍相持約三年。卡面這具希臘重步兵（hoplite）代表密集線隊步兵的結構：地形逼敵展開才成方陣。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 交戰一方是關中扶風郡的亂眾，首領為扶風賊帥唐弼。大業十年二月丁酉，唐弼聚眾至十萬，立同鄉李弘芝為天子，號為唐王，以扶風郡治與汧源縣一帶為根據地；部眾多為逃戶、亡命與屯田逃卒，按渠帥分股行動，號令並不統一，卻共享唐王的名號來凝聚。另一方是隋朝中央與關中郡縣的官軍：扶風太守竇璡據郡城固守，郡兵縣兵奉詔出討；隋廷十二道行軍總管、虎賁郎將、鷹揚郎將的將官體系雖在，關中宿衛與郡兵早已空虛。扶風一地在大業九年先有桑門向海明自稱彌勒、眾至數萬，被太僕卿楊義臣擊破，到大業十年又出唐弼，反映關中三輔反覆成為亂源。最終收拾此役的不是隋廷的正面討伐，而是西秦薛舉父子介入：薛舉遣其子薛仁果寇扶風，唐弼殺李弘芝請降，薛仁果乘其無備襲破其眾，唐弼以數百騎走詣扶風，被郡守竇璡所殺，殘部其後由唐高祖武德年間通議大夫劉世讓招撫安集。
countriesEn: The two sides in this conflict were the insurgents of Fufeng commandery in the Guanzhong plain and the troops of the Sui state. The rebel side was gathered in the spring of 614 by Tang Bi, whom the histories call only the bandit chief of Fufeng; in the second month of the Daye tenth year he mustered a following of one hundred thousand men, set up a fellow villager, Li Hongzhi, as emperor under the title King of Tang, and used the commandery seat of Fufeng together with the county of Qianyuan as his base. His followers were deserters, runaway families and soldiers who had abandoned the tuntian; they were split among local commanders, with no unified chain of command, yet they shared the title King of Tang as a bond. The other side was the Sui court and the commandery and county officials of Guanzhong. Prefect Dou Xian held the commandery city, the commandery and county levies marched out to suppress the rising, and the Sui command structure of the twelve regional armies, the huben langjiang and the yingyang langjiang, was nominally intact, but the palace guards and local troops of Guanzhong had long been hollowed out. Fufeng had already erupted a year earlier, when the monk Xiang Haiming proclaimed himself Maitreya and gathered several tens of thousands, only to be broken by the Grand Master of the Imperial Studials, Yang Yichen; a second eruption in 614 showed how repeatedly the Three Capital District of Guanzhong became a source of revolt. What finally settled the affair was not a Sui offensive but the intervention of the western Qin warlord Xue Ju: Xue Ju sent his son Xue Renguo against Fufeng, Tang Bi killed Li Hongzhi and offered surrender, Xue Renguo struck the new recruits while they were still disordered and absorbed the whole band, and Tang Bi fled with a few hundred horsemen to Fufeng, where the prefect Dou Xian killed him. The survivors were later taken in and pacified by Liu Sherang, a Tongyi Daifu appointed under Li Yuan in the Wude era.
people: 唐弼是這場起義唯一留下姓名的首領，籍貫扶風，資治通鑑只以扶風賊帥稱之，生平事跡幾乎無傳，只知他在大業十年二月聚眾十萬、立李弘芝為唐王，並據汧源拒敵。三年之後，他殺死自己所立的天子李弘芝向薛舉請降，兵眾被薛仁果乘亂襲散，自己帶數百騎奔回扶風向郡守竇璡請降，仍被竇璡所殺，隨行數百騎一併覆沒。李弘芝是亂眾推出來的天子，唐號取自關中周原一帶周室與唐叔的舊望，這個名號把一場地方聚眾起事變成一次公開的割據宣言。竇璡是扶風郡的守臣，隋末平涼奴賊數萬圍扶風數月不能下，殺唐弼之後仍降於唐，官至工部尚書，封燕國公。前一年在扶風平定向海明的太僕卿楊義臣，代表隋廷尚有可用之師；後來西秦的薛舉、薛仁果以父子之兵吃掉唐弼部眾並圍扶風；再往後李淵、李世民入關中，通議大夫劉世讓奉命安集唐弼餘黨，於是這批亂眾的殘部被新朝收編。
peopleEn: Tang Bi is the only leader of this rising whose name survives, and even his biography is almost unknown: the Zizhi Tongjian calls him no more than the bandit chief of Fufeng. We know that in the second month of 614 he gathered a hundred thousand men, enthroned Li Hongzhi as King of Tang and based himself on Qianyuan to resist the imperial troops. Three years later he killed the very emperor he had installed in order to surrender to Xue Ju, his own force was scattered in Xue Renguo's surprise attack, and he rode back to Fufeng with a few hundred horsemen to beg for quarter from the prefect Dou Xian, who killed him all the same; the several hundred riders who followed him perished with him. Li Hongzhi was the puppet emperor put forward by the rebels, and the title Tang drew on the old memory of the Zhou court and the Earl of Tang in the Zhou plain of Guanzhong, turning a local gathering of runaways into a declaration of separatism. Dou Xian, the prefect of Fufeng, was the Sui governor on the ground; when tens of thousands of the Pingliang slave rebels besieged Fufeng for months without taking it, he still held out, and after killing Tang Bi he went over to the Tang, rising to Minister of Works with the title Duke of Yan. The Grand Master of the Imperial Studials Yang Yichen, who had broken the Xiang Haiming rising in Fufeng the year before, represented the usable troops the Sui court still had; the Xiqin warlords Xue Ju and Xue Renguo then swallowed Tang Bi's following and besieged Fufeng; and finally, when Li Yuan and Li Shimin entered Guanzhong, Liu Sherang was sent to pacify Tang Bi's remnants, so that the residue of the rising was absorbed into the army of the new dynasty.
kits: 卡面是希臘重步兵（hoplite），這是公元前五世紀前半葉希臘城邦的公民兵制式裝備：青銅圓盾（aspis）面徑約六十至九十公分，頭戴科林斯式青銅盔，上身披青銅方胸或拼合的肌肉式胸甲，小腿套青銅脛甲，手持約二公尺的希臘短矛與約六十公分的青銅短劍。整套裝備的意義不在單兵而在列陣：盾牌相接、矛尖朝前，一支重裝步兵方陣的正面比單個人結實，必須靠狹窄地形逼敵展開才發揮得出來。放回扶風之役看，雙方真正有的只是各色粗劣兵器：叛軍十萬眾多持耒、鋤、樵斧、戈、矛與少量弓弩，以葛布或獸皮充甲，關中馬匹有限，多靠步卒列線；官軍一方是隋制下的郡兵縣兵，配備以弓弩為主，兵源有河南、山東逃戶與關中募兵，配甲冑、旌旗、鼓角與輜重車馬，攻城則備雲梯、撞車一類器械。唐弼據汧源拒薛仁果，靠的正是渭水上游峽谷與塬梁逼使來軍展開，與希臘重步兵方陣同一個道理：地形決定線隊能不能咬住。須說明的是，希臘重步兵在唐時早已不存於任何軍中，卡面是本站用來對照密集線隊步兵這個兵種結構的切入點，而非指雙方裝備相同。
kitsEn: The card carries a Greek hoplite, the citizen soldier of the Greek city states in the first half of the fifth century BC: a bronze aspis roughly sixty to ninety centimetres across, a Corinthian bronze helmet, a bronze or muscle-pattern cuirass over the torso, bronze greaves on the shins, a Greek dory about two metres long and a bronze xiphos about sixty centimetres. The point of the whole outfit is not the individual soldier but the line: with shields overlapping and spear points forward, the front of a phalanx was stronger than any one man, and it could only work where narrow terrain forced the enemy to deploy. Set against the rising at Fufeng, what the two sides actually had was far cruder: the hundred thousand of the rebels carried hoes, mattocks, axes, halberds, spears and a few crossbows, with hemp cloth or hide for armour, few horses in Guanzhong, and were mostly infantry; the Sui side fought with commandery and county levies whose main weapons were bows and crossbows, recruited heavily from deserters out of Henan and Shandong and from local volunteers, with armour, banners, drums and horns and draught animals for the baggage, and scaling ladders and battering beams for siege work. Tang Bi's refusal to give way to Xue Renguo at Qianyuan was won on exactly the principle of the phalanx: the gorges and loess ridges of the upper Wei valley forced an approaching army to deploy in line, where infantry could hold. It should be said plainly that Greek hoplites existed in no Sui army; the card is the site's way of setting up the structure of dense line infantry, not a claim that the two sides carried the same equipment.
tactics: 起義本身的戰術，幾乎全由地形與號召決定。大業十年二月隋廷下詔復徵天下兵、百道俱進，關中青壯大量隨軍北去，扶風一帶留下的多是不能遷徙的家口與走投無路的逃戶，唐弼得以在數月之間聚起十萬眾。這樣的眾既無軍紀，也無後方，行動準則是結眾自保、劫掠郡縣、斷官軍糧道、襲擊出城的小股郡兵：扶風郡治與汧源縣一帶有山塬與深溝，騎兵施展不開，密集的步卒線隊在塬梁上列開，反倒佔盡便宜。亂眾需要一個共主的名號，李弘芝的唐王因此成了聚眾的旗幟，並與同年關中其他起事、北方劉迦論與離石劉苗王等遙相呼應，使官軍疲於奔命。官軍一方的戰術則沿用隋代體制：以虎賁郎將、鷹揚郎將等為將官，郡兵縣兵為骨幹，出郡城討賊，倚靠長安的糧秣與關中宿衛作後盾。大業九年太僕卿楊義臣能一役破平扶風向海明的數萬眾，說明彼時關中尚有可用的兵；此後兵不再肯戰，討平不了了之。與希臘重步兵方陣相比，這場起義缺的正是方陣的三個前提：裝備同質、紀律嚴整、能守住列陣的地形。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the rising were decided by terrain and by the need to rally a crowd. In the second month of 614 the Sui court ordered a new levy for the third campaign against Goguryeo and all armies to move on every route at once; the young men of Guanzhong were drawn off north with the army, and what was left in Fufeng was a population that could not move and men adrift from everywhere, and it took Tang Bi only a few months to gather one hundred thousand of them. Such a host had neither discipline nor a rear area; its rules of action were to band together for survival, plunder the commanderies, cut the supply road of the imperial troops and fall on small detachments of county soldiers sent out of the walled towns. Around the commandery seat of Fufeng and the county of Qianyuan the country was cut by hills, ridges and gullies where cavalry had no room to work and where a dense line of foot could deploy to advantage. The rebels needed a common ruler to hold them together, and the title King of Tang carried by Li Hongzhi served as that banner, echoing the other risings of the time in Guanzhong and in the north, such as Liu Jialun at Yan'an and Liu Miaowang at Lishi, and tying down imperial troops everywhere. On the government side the Sui system was followed: huben langjiang and yingyang langjiang as officers, commandery and county levies as the backbone, sorties from the walled city, with the grain of Chang'an as the supply base and the palace guards of Guanzhong as the reserve. Yang Yichen's destruction of the several tens of thousands under Xiang Haiming in 613 showed that Guanzhong still had usable troops then; after that the troops no longer fought, and the rising was never settled. Compared with the Greek phalanx, this rising lacked the three preconditions of the formation: uniform equipment, strict discipline, and ground that could be held in line.
data: 史籍可核的數字集中在兵力與時間兩端。起事時間是大業十年二月丁酉，通鑑記其眾十萬，與同年陝西延安劉迦論自稱皇王、眾十萬相當，是關中大亂時期規模最大的一批亂眾之一。前一年大業九年，扶風桑門向海明自稱彌勒出世、眾至數萬，自稱皇帝改元白烏，被太僕卿楊義臣擊破，說明扶風一帶的聚眾起事並非孤立事件；同年七月楊玄感起兵於黎陽、旋在萊州遇害，隋廷以車刑懸示並誅連黨與千餘家。大業十年二月隋廷再議伐高句麗、復徵天下兵，三月帝行幸涿郡而士卒在道亡者相繼，八月自懷遠鎮班師，所徵兵多失期不至。距大業七年王薄在長白山首義已三年有餘，全國同時起事者眾多：張大虎、劉迦論、劉苗王、王德仁、楊公卿各擁眾或數千或數萬不等。唐弼一支自 614 年二月起事，到 617 年兵眾被薛仁果襲併、首領被殺，前後約三年，是隋末少數能撐過三年而未為官軍解決的亂事。地理上，扶風郡治在今陝西扶風、岐山一帶，汧源縣在今寶雞市西部至甘肅隴縣一帶，距扶風郡城約五十餘公里，至長安約一百七十公里，關中道路沿渭河與山塬分佈，糧秣調度全靠陸路牛車與人背。
dataEn: The figures the records support cluster around strength and duration. The rising is dated to the dingyou day of the second month of Daye year ten, 614, and the Tongjian gives its strength as one hundred thousand men, comparable to Liu Jialun in Yan'an in the same year, who called himself king and also claimed a hundred thousand, and among the largest bands raised in the collapse of Guanzhong. A year earlier, in 613, the Fufeng monk Xiang Haiming had proclaimed the coming of Maitreya, gathered several tens of thousands, styled himself emperor and changed the era to Baiwu, only to be broken by Yang Yichen; in the same year, in the seventh month, Yang Xuansang rose at Liyang and was killed at Laizhou, the court displaying his body on a wheel-frame and executing more than a thousand households. In the second month of 614 the court debated the campaign against Goguryeo once more and levied troops again; in the third month the emperor travelled to Zhuojun and soldiers died on the road; in the eighth month he returned from Huaiyuan, and the levies summoned had largely failed to arrive. Three years had passed since Wang Bo's first rising at Changbaishan in 611, and risings were everywhere: Zhang Dahuo, Liu Jialun, Liu Miaowang, Wang Deren and Yang Gongqing each led thousands or tens of thousands. Tang Bi's band lasted from the second month of 614 until 617, when it was taken by surprise and absorbed by Xue Renguo and its leader killed, roughly three years in all, which is long for a late Sui rising. Geographically the commandery seat of Fufeng lies around present-day Fufeng and Qishan in Shaanxi, and Qianyuan county in the west of today's Baoji in Shaanxi and around Longxian in Gansu, about fifty kilometres from the commandery seat and some a hundred and seventy kilometres from Chang'an; the roads of Guanzhong run along the Wei river and the ridges, so grain moved only by ox cart and by human back.
cause: 起義的直接契機是大業十年二月的一道詔令。隋廷在第三次征高句麗之前再議伐戰，復徵天下兵、百道俱進，關中一帶的青壯與畜力被抽往涿郡行在所，扶風郡內留下的是無力遷徙的戶口與流落各地的亡命者，這些人只要有一名渠帥登高一呼，就能迅速結眾。更深一層的原因是隋朝兵制的崩壞：文帝時府兵已廢，宿衛改用募編的驍果，郡縣的府兵轉為兵合於農，徵發無常，郡兵空虛而無可靠訓練；大業年間三次征高句麗、兩度巡遊江都，把河南、山東的丁口一帶帶走，關中糧食反而要先從關外運入，郡兵出城討賊往往缺糧而潰。扶風一帶在起義之前一年已爆發桑門向海明自稱彌勒的聚眾，被楊義臣平定後，彌勒式的末世號召仍留在民間的記憶裡；唐弼索性拋開彌勒，直接立一位天子、號唐王，用一個正統的名號替亂眾找到了共同目標。關中又是周室與唐叔的故地，扶風一帶的周原正是唐人自視為祖居的地方，唐號在此地格外能召人。
causeEn: The immediate trigger was an edict of the second month of 614. Before the third campaign against Goguryeo the Sui court debated once more and levied troops for every route, and the young men and draught animals of Guanzhong were pulled away to the ruler's camp at Zhuojun; what remained in Fufeng commandery were mouths that could not move and men adrift from everywhere, and once a single local commander called them together they coalesced into a host within weeks. Deeper down lies the collapse of Sui military institutions: the fubing system had already been abolished under Emperor Wen, the palace guard was replaced by recruited strong fellows, and the commandery troops were folded into the peasant system, with no fixed term of service and no dependable training. Three campaigns against Goguryeo and two tours to Jiangdu drew off the men of Henan and Shandong, while the grain for Guanzhong had to be brought in from beyond the passes, and county soldiers marching out of their towns often starved and dissolved. The year before the rising, a monk in Fufeng had already proclaimed Maitreya and gathered a crowd; although Yang Yichen broke that rising, the millenarian appeal stayed in popular memory. Tang Bi therefore dropped the Maitreya pose and set up a real emperor under the title King of Tang, giving the crowd a common and legitimate aim. Guanzhong was also the homeland of the Zhou court and the Earl of Tang, and the Zhou plain around Fufeng was the place the Tang themselves claimed as their ancestral home, so the word Tang carried extra weight there.
impact: 這場起義在隋末的意義，首先是把關中三輔的失序攤到了明處。大業九年扶風的向海明還能被一員太僕卿在短時間內打散，大業十年唐弼卻能立天子、號唐王、聚眾十萬，隋廷此後三年沒有把它解決，最後是西秦薛舉父子吃掉叛眾、扶風太守竇璡殺了唐弼才收場，中央對關中的控制只剩郡守個人的影響力。第二，它為唐的入關提供了直接條件：關中既有饑荒又有亂兵，隋廷主力又遠在江都，李淵、李世民得以在關中以安集餘黨和討伐薛舉兩手收編、擊破各路勢力，通議大夫劉世讓奉命招撫唐弼餘黨正是其中一環。事後看，614 年扶風有人搶先打出唐號，與兩年後李淵建國的國號同地同名，被後世史家視為唐室興起的一個預兆。第三，對兵種史而言，這一役也說明密集線隊步兵的真實極限：沒有同質裝備、沒有嚴整紀律、沒有可守的地形，十萬眾也不會自動變成方陣，扶風之役的勝負最後由糧秣、募兵制度與號召決定，而不是由某一種制式武器決定。
impactEn: The first significance of this rising is that it exposed the disorder of the Three Capital District of Guanzhong. In 613 the Fufeng rising of Xiang Haiming could still be broken in a short time by a single high official; in 614 Tang Bi could proclaim an emperor, style himself King of Tang and gather a hundred thousand men, and the court failed to settle it for three years. The rising was resolved at last not by a Sui offensive but by the Xiqin warlords swallowing the rebels and by the prefect Dou Xian killing Tang Bi; central authority over Guanzhong had come down to the personal reach of a single prefect. Second, the rising gave the Tang a direct opportunity in the pass: Guanzhong was short of food and full of armed bands, the main Sui armies were stuck at Jiangdu, and Li Yuan and Li Shimin could both absorb the local groups by pacifying their remnants and by defeating Xue Ju, with Liu Sherang sent to take in Tang Bi's leftovers as one of these moves. Seen afterwards, the fact that in 614 someone in Fufeng raised the title Tang before Li Yuan founded the Tang dynasty two years later, in the same place and with the same word, has been read by historians as a token of the dynasty's rise. Third, for the history of arms this affair shows the real limit of dense line infantry: without uniform equipment, strict discipline and ground that can be held, a hundred thousand men do not become a phalanx by themselves, and the outcome at Fufeng was settled by grain, by the recruitment system and by the appeal of a name, not by any one standard weapon.
result: 唐弼起義以失敗告終，而且是被三方力量各取一段地收拾掉的。大業十年二月立唐王之後，扶風郡城由竇璡堅守，亂眾在汧源與郡境內以據點自保、劫掠往來，官軍多次出討無功，這場叛亂在隋朝的正統紀年裡持續了約三年。轉折出現在大業十三年：薛舉遣其子薛仁果寇扶風，唐弼為自保殺掉李弘芝請降，薛仁果趁其新附未整襲破之，唐弼部眾被全部併入薛軍，唐弼本人帶數百騎奔回扶風向竇璡請降，仍被竇璡殺死，所部覆沒。僭號的唐王名號隨之消失，殘部則在隋亡後由劉世讓招撫安集，其中一部分併入唐軍。隋朝保住了扶風郡城，卻已失去關中；一年後李淵入長安，618 年隋亡。這一役之後，關中再沒有任何一股勢力能獨力維持秩序，最終代替隋室收拾殘局的，是關中那支新興的武裝集團。
resultEn: The Tang Bi rising ended in failure, and it was tidied away in three parts by three different parties. After Li Hongzhi was set up as King of Tang in the second month of 614, the commandery city of Fufeng was held by Dou Xian while the rebels held strongpoints in Qianyuan and along the borders of the commandery, raiding and holding out; imperial sorties repeatedly failed, and the revolt dragged on for about three years in the official chronology of the Sui. The turning point came in 617: Xue Ju sent his son Xue Renguo against Fufeng, Tang Bi killed Li Hongzhi and offered to surrender, Xue Renguo attacked the new recruits while they were still settling in and took them, and Tang Bi's force was absorbed wholesale by the Xue army. Tang Bi himself rode back to Fufeng with a few hundred horsemen to surrender to Dou Xian, who killed him all the same, and those who followed him were wiped out. The false title of King of Tang disappeared with him, and the remnants were taken in and settled by Liu Sherang after the fall of the Sui, some of them being absorbed into Tang troops. The Sui kept the city of Fufeng but lost Guanzhong; a year later Li Yuan entered Chang'an and in 618 the Sui ended. After this affair no single force in Guanzhong could keep order alone, and the group that finally took over the Sui's inheritance was a new military coalition from that same region.
